Source/selection review: APPLY or RETURN. Candidate/manual intake: ACCEPT or REJECT. Random QA: CORRECT or INCORRECT.
Inspect the source and requested correction
Unhide SOURCE CORRECTIONS only when the task asks for field changes, then choose APPLY or RETURN.
Unhide SOURCE CORRECTIONS, complete operator_selection_decision, and add a note when remaining PENDING.
Unhide CANDIDATE DETAILS, complete missing fields, then choose ACCEPT or REJECT. No new source is auto-accepted.
Routine Cycle identifies it, searches registered metadata for an official route, and creates a task for missing information.
The current valid source is retained unless the replacement validates successfully. System1 never bypasses a paywall.
Verify the sampled source record and file
Choose CORRECT or INCORRECT. An incorrect result creates a correction task.
Unhide SOURCE CORRECTIONS, choose operator_selection_decision, select APPLY, enter your name, and run Routine Cycle.
Verify the official URL, add a corrected retrieval URL if available, select APPLY, and run Routine Cycle. A failed retry preserves the current valid file.
Copy the file to Data/00_Human_Intake, run Routine Cycle, complete the candidate task, and choose ACCEPT only after provenance and applicability are confirmed.
Install Python 3.11+, run the platform setup script, copy config templates, then run python -m system1 doctor.
Edit schedule.json and register it with the platform script. Moving the System1 folder requires unregistering and registering again.
Do not edit while System1 writes
When making manual changes, pause or avoid the scheduled run. Excel-open and process locks prevent unsafe writes.
Keep Excel closed, copy the latest backup from Code/runtime/backups, and run Validate Environment before retrying.
Wait for the current run to finish, then use View Last Run.
Use Human Operation Desktop for a corrected route or an authorised manual replacement.
